surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process uses alternating pulses of Al(CH3)3 (the Al precursor) and H2O (the oxygen precursor) in a carrier N2 gas flow to deposit an 8-nm-thick Al2O3 oxide layer. The text does not provide specific surface reaction equations or detailed mechanisms for the surface chemistry.
evidence: A 8-nm-thick Al2O3 oxide layer was deposited at a substrate temperature of 300 °C, by using alternating pulses of Al(CH3)3 (the Al precursor) and H2O (the oxygen precursor) in a carrier N2 gas flow.
